The staircase wrapped in Costa Rican teak reflects the level of craftsmanship found across the home. LXHR14228.title: Casa Armoniq @ Hacienda Espinal
LXHR14228.description: Casa Armoniq at Hacienda Espinal is a contemporary family home under construction in San Rafael de Alajuela, within Costa Rica’s Central Valley. Designed with three bedrooms, two levels, generous social areas, a terrace, BBQ area, deck, pool, and garden, the home offers an open and fresh living environment in one of the area’s newer and sought after residential communities. The first level is planned around a welcoming foyer that leads into the main living spaces. This floor includes a half bathroom, living room, dining room, kitchen with a spacious pantry, terrace with BBQ area, deck, pool, laundry area, and a service bedroom with bathroom. The layout gives the home a practical flow for family life, entertaining, and relaxed outdoor living. The second level includes a TV room, a principal bedroom with generous spaces and a balcony, two secondary bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and closet, and an office. The secondary bedrooms and office share a balcony area with a beautiful view, adding a comfortable connection to the surrounding setting. Natural light and cross ventilation are important parts of the home’s design. The interiors are planned to feel bright, fresh, and well ventilated, with air conditioning included in the bedrooms. The home is delivered with kitchen appliances including a cooktop, extractor, oven tower, and air conditioning units in the bedrooms. Hacienda Espinal in San Rafael de Alajuela offers a residential setting within Costa Rica’s Central Valley, with a rural atmosphere that distinguishes it from more urban areas such as Escazú and Santa Ana while still remaining connected to their services and lifestyle options. The community is planned around a healthy, family oriented way of living, with security, sports, entertainment, and social amenities integrated into the neighborhood. Community amenities include a clubhouse with two spacious air conditioned social areas, a bar and kitchen, an outdoor pool, soccer fields, tennis courts, and a gym with machines and equipment. Country Day School recently opened its new campus within Hacienda Espinal, and nearby supermarkets include Auto Mercado and Vindi. Casa Armoniq brings together contemporary design, generous family spaces, outdoor living, and the established community lifestyle of Hacienda Espinal in San Rafael de Alajue

LXER14221.title: Casa Valenza @ Los Reyes
LXER14221.description: Casa Valenza at Hacienda Los Reyes in La Guácima, Costa Rica, is a modern and spacious home designed around light, scale, and a strong connection between its interior social areas and outdoor living spaces. With four bedrooms, several areas for entertaining, a generous terrace, and a large patio with a fire pit, the home offers a refined yet highly livable setting within one of Costa Rica’s established residential and golf communities. The arrival sets a composed tone, with a contemporary facade, clean architectural lines, and a broad entry sequence framed by landscaping. Inside, the foyer is notably spacious, creating a sense of openness from the first moment. Natural stone details, large format flooring, dark wood accents, and carefully placed lighting give the interiors a polished modern character without feeling overly formal. To the left of the entrance is a guest bedroom or office with its own bathroom, allowing flexibility for visitors, work, or private use. To the right, the guest bath features detailed finishes and natural stone, continuing the home’s emphasis on texture and material quality. A short set of steps leads to the main living and dining area, where the home’s sense of light becomes especially clear. The dining room features a striking dark table, pendant lighting, textured wall treatment, and an easy connection to the adjacent living area. The kitchen can be integrated or separated through a wood door, offering practical flexibility for family life, entertaining, or more formal hosting. Beyond the living area, the bar and lounge create an additional social setting with a long counter, seating, and wide openings toward the garden. Sliding glass doors allow the main social spaces to connect directly with the covered terrace, where several seating areas, an outdoor kitchen, ceiling fans, and views to the lawn shape a relaxed extension of the home. The patio includes a fire pit area and ample green space, adding another layer to the property’s entertaining capacity. On this same level, the home includes the laundry area and a service bedroom. The second floor brings together a TV room, an office, two secondary bedrooms each with its own closet and bathroom, and the principal bedroom with a walk-in closet and private bath. The layout gives the home a clear separation between active social areas and more private upstairs living. Hacienda Los Reyes offers a residential setting in La Guácima, Alajuela, with access to nature, sports oriented amenities, and nearby services. The community includes a private and independent country club with amenities such as a soccer field, gym, tennis court, lap pools, swimming pools, massage rooms, and saunas, as well as the only Polo Club in the country within the same vicinity. Private membership is required for the Polo Club and golf course. The area also offers access to trails, landscaped gardens, and proximity to Auto Mercado, Country Day, GSD, Escazú, Santa Ana, Juan Santamaría Airport, and the Pacific Coast via Route 27. LXHR14162.title: Vista Privee Home @ Heredia
LXHR14162.description: Vista Privee Home @ Heredia is located in Santa Bárbara de Heredia, in the western part of Costa Rica’s Central Valley, and brings together privacy, contemporary design, and a strong connection to its natural surroundings. Set in one of Heredia’s most established residential areas, the property enjoys panoramic views across the Central Valley, mountain backdrops, and sunsets that shape the atmosphere of the home every day. With a main house, guest house, terraces, and pool, Vista Privee Home is designed for buyers who value space, natural light, and independence in Costa Rica. The architecture is contemporary and clean, with open social areas and a fluid relationship between the interior and exterior spaces. Floor to ceiling windows bring in abundant natural light and frame the landscape throughout the home. The living room, dining room, bar, and kitchen connect naturally, creating a layout that feels open and functional for daily living as well as entertaining. From these spaces, the transition to the terrace and pool is immediate, with the mountains, the Central Valley, and the sunsets as the backdrop. As a fully independent home, the property offers a level of privacy and freedom that stands apart from living in a gated community. The main level includes the living and dining areas, which open onto a large terrace and pool, along with the kitchen, laundry area, service bedroom and bathroom, storage room, and parking. The overall layout is practical, with generous spaces throughout. On the second level, the home includes a TV room, two spacious secondary bedrooms, each with its own closet and full bathroom, and the primary bedroom. The primary suite stands out for its scale, private bathroom, and walk-in closet, creating a comfortable and well organized private area within the house. In addition, the property includes a separate guest house that adds flexibility for visitors, extended family, or a variety of other uses. This house includes an office area, a very spacious kitchen, one secondary bedroom with a closet and bathroom, and a primary bedroom with a walk -in closet and bathroom. It also includes an attic, laundry area, service bedroom, patio, and a large storage room. Santa Bárbara offers a setting that balances a more traditional town atmosphere with convenient access to Heredia, Alajuela, and San José. It is located approximately 15 minutes from Juan Santamaría International Airport and 14 kilometers from San José. The area is known for its temperate climate, green hills, coffee landscapes, local restaurants, family owned businesses, and access to daily services. Nearby are private schools, universities such as Universidad Nacional and Universidad Latina, and supermarkets including Automercado. Altogether, Vista Privee Home @ Heredia offers a refined residential setting for those seeking views, privacy, generous space, and a strategic location

LXCR14117.title: Granadilla Single-level Independent Home
LXCR14117.description: Granadilla Flat Independent Home is a fully renovated single level residence in Granadilla, Costa Rica, combining vintage character with modern finishes in a well located residential setting. Designed for privacy, natural light, and open living, the home offers generous social spaces, terraces, a garden, and integrated security features, creating a comfortable option for those seeking an independent home in the eastern side of San José. A double gate opens to the property and provides comfortable parking for up to six vehicles inside. From the main entrance, the home opens into a spacious social area where the living and dining spaces can be arranged with flexibility. LXHR13296.title: Nouvelle Home at Hacienda Espinal

Set in Stage 3 of this renowned community in Costa Rica's Central Valley, Nouvelle Home offers double-height ceilings and a spacious layout that creates a bright, airy atmosphere. The exterior combines sleek gray and white tones with warm wood accents for a touch of natural elegance. All within the sought-after residential community of Hacienda Espinal northwest of San José, on the route 27 highway that connects Escazú and Santa Ana to the Pacific Coast. Entering Nouvelle Home, you are greeted by an open-concept living area that seamlessly integrates the living room, dining room, and kitchen. The high ceilings and abundant natural light enhance the sense of space, while the neutral color palette, complemented by warm flooring and kitchen accents, creates a cozy yet sophisticated environment. The kitchen is designed for both comfort and function, with a central island that doubles as a breakfast bar and ample storage space. On the upper floor, a central TV room serves as a cozy family gathering space, complete with a custom-built entertainment unit. LXER14211.title: Prism Penthouse
LXER14211.description: Prism Penthouse Escazú offers contemporary penthouse living in Escazú, on the western side of the Central Valley of Costa Rica, with panoramic views, abundant natural light, generous interiors, and a walkable location close to restaurants, cafés, shops, supermarkets, and essential services. The residence feels open and bright from the moment you enter, with expansive windows framing the surrounding Escazú landscape and inviting the views into the main living areas. The kitchen is integrated into the social area and includes a large island with seating, built-in appliances, dark countertops, and streamlined cabinetry. It is positioned to serve both the dining area and main living space, keeping the home connected and practical without interrupting the openness of the layout. One of the defining features of Prism Penthouse Escazú is the expansive mezzanine with beautiful views and a full bathroom. This upper level brings meaningful flexibility to the home, whether used as a family room, home office, guest suite, gym, or entertainment area. The home features 3 spacious bedrooms, including an ample primary suite with it’s primary bathroom, which continues the contemporary design language with dual vessel sinks, glass enclosed shower space, a bathtub, and neutral finishes. LXHR14082.description: Serene Home @ Los Reyes is a contemporary five bedroom residence in Hacienda Los Reyes in La Guácima, Alajuela, with refined wood detailing, a bright indoor-outdoor layout, and a generous pool and terrace setting designed for everyday comfort and entertaining. The home, located in the northwestern area of the Central Valley of Costa Rica, is defined by its fresh, open feel and thoughtful connectivity between spaces. On the main level, the living room, dining areas, and an expansive kitchen can be integrated into one large social environment alongside the terrace, BBQ area, and pool. These living areas are designed to communicate easily, creating an effortless sense of flow while still allowing you to choose how open or private each zone feels. When you prefer more separation, the layout allows these areas to be separated and enjoyed with more privacy, without losing the natural connection between them. Oversized windows line the interior circulation and the primary social spaces, bringing in abundant natural light and framing views toward the patio, pool, and garden greenery. The kitchen features white cabinetry and granite countertops in warm neutral tones, anchored by a central island that also functions as a breakfast bar. Sliding glass doors open directly to the terrace, making outdoor dining and hosting feel seamless. The terrace experience is a major focal point. It functions like an extension of the interior, with space to dine outdoors, a dedicated BBQ area, and direct access to the pool. The pool area is notably spacious, complemented by a landscaped garden and sundeck that create a calm, vacation-like rhythm to daily life. The living room also connects to the terrace along one side, while a more formal dining room sits on the other. This constant relationship with the outdoors helps keep the home airy and bright throughout the day. On the first floor, you will also find a dedicated office area with a full bathroom, adding flexibility for working from home or accommodating additional daily needs. Upstairs, the second level includes a TV lounge, three secondary bedrooms each with its own bathroom, and the primary suite. These rooms are described as generous in size and enjoy beautiful outlooks, with large windows and, in some cases, small balconies that reinforce the connection to the outdoors. The residence is located within a sub-gated community of Hacienda Los Reyes, offering double security. Hacienda Los Reyes spans nearly 100 acres, and owners can enjoy mountain views and a forest reserve backdrop. Amenities include a soccer field, gym, tennis court, and training and leisure pools, a sauna, and the possibility to become a member of the polo club and golf club of Los Reyes. The community also offers kilometers of walking trails through landscaped gardens and natural surroundings. Hacienda Los Reyes is positioned near an Auto Mercado and international schools such as Country Day and GSD. La Guácima is noted for its continued growth while maintaining a more rural, relaxed atmosphere, distinct from denser areas of San José. LXER12979.title: Vista Verde Single-Level Home in Lindora
LXER12979.description: Elegance and spaciousness in an exclusive natural setting. Located in the prestigious Bosques de Lindora community on the west side of San José, Vista Verde Single-Level Home is a 4-bedroom residence set on an expansive 1,080 m² lot. Designed for those seeking comfort, privacy, and exclusivity, this home seamlessly blends classic charm with modern functionality. Plus, living in this exclusive community means quick and easy access to the best entertainment, dining, shopping, and luxury living in Santa Ana, Escazú, and San José. A grand entrance with warm, elegant double wooden doors welcomes you into Vista Verde, leading to an inviting foyer. The social area integrates the living and dining spaces in a bright, open concept layout, with direct access to a covered and enclosed terrace. The terrace is one of the home’s highlights, featuring a sophisticated design with gracefully arched glass windows and robust columns that enhance its elegance. Exposed wooden beams add warmth and character, while floor to ceiling windows fully open, connecting the terrace to the backyard and offering the perfect space for outdoor living with added protection from the elements. The landscaped garden is equipped with an automatic irrigation system, making outdoor maintenance both practical and efficient. To the left of the entrance, Vista Verde’s spacious kitchen exudes classic charm with rich wooden cabinetry. The kitchen is designed for practicality, offering ample workspace and a cozy breakfast bar for casual meals. This area is complemented by a large laundry room with its own storage area, a dedicated service bedroom, and abundant storage throughout the home. Vista Verde offers four storage areas in total, including two attic storage spaces, a large exterior storage room in the garden, and an additional storage area in the laundry room. The home’s high ceilings, cross ventilation, and expansive windows maximize natural light and airflow, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout. The private wing of the home is located to the right, featuring a TV room, an office, and four spacious bedrooms, each with its own en suite bathroom and closet. The master suite is a true retreat, boasting a large walk in closet and a luxurious private bathroom. Vista Verde Single-Level Home includes two covered parking spaces, with additional capacity for six more vehicles in the exterior parking area. Bosques de Lindora is one of Santa Ana’s most exclusive residential communities, known for its top tier security and family friendly atmosphere. Residents enjoy a luxurious clubhouse with a swimming pool, two tennis courts, a basketball court, and more than three hectares of green spaces, including a playground. Lindora is a vibrant and highly convenient area that offers immediate access to essential services such as high end supermarkets, renowned medical institutions, and prestigious schools. The proximity to shopping centers and corporate hubs makes it a prime location for modern living. With direct access to Route 27, residents can reach Juan Santamaría International Airport in just 20 minutes and the stunning beaches of Costa Rica’s Pacific coast in under an hour. Next to the living room, through a middle wall that partly separates both areas, a secondary living room featuring the same floor design is offered. Two small balconies with the same remarkable views fill the space with natural light and ventilation. In 2021, it was completely remodeled by architect Esteban Madriz, transforming it into a modern and perfectly maintained residence. The double entrance doors lead to the foyer of Modern Oasis Single-Level Home offering a refreshing atmosphere throughout the social areas that unfold with a double-height ceiling. The living and dining rooms, bright and spacious, seamlessly integrate with the large terrace and patio, framed by imposing dark columns that contrast with the lighter tones of the space. The large glass doors allow natural light to flow freely and offer views of the patio and garden from all the social areas, adding a touch of serenity to the environment. The kitchen at Modern Oasis Single-Level Home, located to the left of the foyer, is a modern and functional space equipped with high-quality appliances from Electrolux and Kitchen Aid. Its elegant design is complemented by a central island and light-colored surfaces that reflect natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, the kitchen seamlessly connects to the terrace and patio, offering direct access that makes food preparation and outdoor gatherings convenient and enjoyable. To one side of the patio, there’s an additional space that can function as an office, guest bedroom, or playroom, depending on the needs of its residents. This versatile space has its own bathroom and private exit, offering independence and convenience. Two of its walls are made of glass, allowing abundant natural light to enter and giving it a modern and sophisticated look. The flexibility of this room makes it ideal for adapting to various functions, making it a highly valuable space within the home. Next, there are two secondary bedrooms, each with its own closet and full bathroom. Finally, the master bedroom features a spacious walk-in closet and a very large bathroom. Its sliding doors open directly onto the terrace, allowing for private access to the outdoors. To the left of the foyer is the guest bathroom, completely remodeled and decorated with a beautiful wallpaper that adds a distinctive touch to the space. On this same side, you will also find the laundry area and the service bedroom, offering functionality and convenience to the home. All the bathrooms in the house are finished with high-quality materials, standing out for their impeccable design. Additionally, the house is equipped with an integrated audio system and has double-glazed windows that improve energy efficiency and offer better sound insulation. Río Oro enjoys warm weather throughout the year. It’s a safe and peaceful area, easily accessible from both the old road connecting Escazú and Santa Ana and Route 27. Río Oro is just 10 minutes from Escazú and even closer to Lindora, making it a strategic location for those seeking the convenience of being close to urban services while also enjoying a serene environment. The home combines a double-height entry, natural light, and a seamless connection to the surrounding garden, creating a balanced living environment within a residential setting. The garden wraps around the home and is filled with tropical plants, bringing greenery into view from multiple areas of the house. It features generous proportions, green-toned cabinetry, natural stone countertops, and a direct connection to the dining area. A large window opens toward a smaller terrace, adding light and ventilation. The stairs lead to an upper-level TV lounge that overlooks the social areas below. LXER14149.title: RetroModern Apartment

A balcony wraps around the social area and frames views of Parque del Café, while engineered wood flooring runs throughout the apartment and brings warmth to the overall design. Also to the right of the social area is the primary bedroom, accessed through a wood clad wall that creates a more private transition. The material palette remains consistent here, reinforcing the apartment’s original industrial expression with a more residential sense of comfort. To the left of the entry vestibule are the secondary bedrooms, which share a bathroom finished with white and blue green tile, a wood vanity, and a white quartz countertop. Along this hallway there is also a linen closet, and at the end, a service room with a full bathroom. LXCR14172.title: Koi Peace Home @ Lakota
LXCR14172.description: Koi Peace Home at Lakota is a country style residence designed to feel fresh, open, and closely connected to its natural surroundings. Located in Lakota, a private community in the mountains of San Ramón de Tres Ríos, east of Costa Rica’s Central Valley, the home combines a more tranquil setting with practical access to San José. Its mostly single level layout, open interior composition, and strong relationship to gardens and natural light give the property a calm and livable character from the outset. From the exterior, the home presents a warm and welcoming feel, with a front garden, covered parking for two vehicles, and architectural details that introduce its design language early on. Once inside, the sense of openness becomes more apparent. A covered interior garden with transparent roof panels brings daylight into the center of the home and helps connect the different spaces in a natural way. Arched openings repeat throughout the interior, softening transitions and giving the home a distinct personality while maintaining privacy in the more private areas. From here, the social area comes into view across an open passage with two steps and space for dry gardens or potted plants on either side. The living and dining area features high ceilings that add openness, while the exposed wood details provide a warm architectural accent. To the right of the social area, the kitchen offers ample workspace, white granite countertops, and room for a television lounge. Its position allows direct access to both the dining area and the terrace, creating an efficient setting for everyday use and entertaining. The dining area and kitchen integrate seamlessly into this layout, forming the home’s social hub. The foyer boasts an exquisite brick wall and stone floors, connecting to the private, social and kitchen areas of the home. Directly ahead, the social area features porcelanato floors and double-height, curved ceilings. To one side, the guest house offers two beds, a full bathroom, air conditioning and a fully equipped and independent place to stay in. Back inside, Azalea’s kitchen connects to the guest bathroom in the foyer and conveniently to the dining room through a double-swing door. Brick detailing and a central, granite counter characterizes this area. The kitchen features wood cabinets, stainless steel appliances and natural ventilation and lighting through expansive windows. The private area offers two secondary bedrooms, each with a closet, wood floors and a bathroom with granite countertops. An office space and TV room with custom-made furniture complement the family quarters. Both the bedrooms offer wood floors, their own private bathroom with marble countertops and access to a balcony through glass sliding doors. LXCR14265.title: The Corner Home @ Tierras del Este

The home presents an elegant corner facade with a classic design that offers a timeless feel. A front stairway framed by gardens leads to the main entrance, while large windows bring abundant natural light into the interiors. Upon entry, a stone clad wall creates a graceful vestibule that adds both character and privacy before opening into the main living room. The living area is spacious and welcoming, with high ceilings, porcelain floors, a decorative stone wall, and an open layout designed for family living or receiving guests. Adjacent to this space is a versatile game room with a bar area, sink, and direct access to the terrace, creating a natural extension for informal gatherings. Curridabat is one of the most desired residential areas along the eastern corridor of San José, known for established neighborhoods, a high quality of life, and proximity to key urban services. LXSL13737.title: Distinguished Playa Hermosa Beachfront Lot

This is more than land—it’s the foundation for a legacy.
